attempts.summary: Configured daily logrotate for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 with 7 compressed rotations and copytruncate (so the writing application's open file descriptor stays valid and it continues writing after rotation without needing a signal/restart). Verified via forced rotation with a live writer process: compressed backup created, app.log truncated, and the writer kept appending seamlessly. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, issued a native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified the logrotate config, rotated .gz file, and app.log contents all survived and remain functionally correct post-restart.
